entities.summary: Bani Yas Island, a notable figure in the history of United Arab Emirates, associated with Pre-Islamic and Early Islamic Gulf Coast (300 BCE–632). Preceded by Sassanid Period and Christianity. Their legacy influenced Advent of Islam and Julfar and Tribes of the region accept Islam; some participate in the Ridda Wars.
